# TestCraft AI

> Free online examination platform and automated grading studio for teachers, educators, and schools. Create customizable exams with MCQs (including multi-select partial credit), True/False questions, and AI-evaluated subjective theory questions. Share instant short test links with students—no student login or account required.

## Key Information
- Canonical Website: https://testcraftai.online/
- Full LLM Documentation: https://testcraftai.online/llms-full.txt
- Primary Purpose: Educational assessment authoring, student exam delivery, automated objective grading, and conceptual AI subjective theory grading
- Target Users: Teachers, professors, tutors, coaching institutes, schools, and academic trainers
- Pricing: 100% Free (no credit card or subscription required)
- Authentication: Optional Google Firebase Authentication for instructors; zero login required for students

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. AI Conceptual Theory Answer Evaluator
- Evaluates written descriptive/subjective answers conceptually against teacher-provided reference model answers
- Powered by Google Gemini AI with semantic synonym and conceptual depth analysis
- Focuses on understanding: does not penalize students for using different wording, synonyms, or simpler phrasing as long as key concepts are communicated
- Output metrics: Marks awarded, concept match percentage (0-100%), accuracy score (out of 10), conceptual verdict, identified strengths, missing points, and rubric notes

### 2. Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) Engine
- Dynamic options count (2 to 6 options per question)
- Supports single-correct and multiple-correct options
- Configurable partial marking: Award half marks (50% partial credit) or strict zero marks for partially correct multi-select answers

### 3. True / False Exam Creator
- Rapid binary question authoring with automated instant verification and grading

### 4. Zero-Login Student Exam Portal
- Frictionless access: Students open the test link on any phone, tablet, or laptop, enter their name and roll number, and take the exam immediately
- Single-attempt enforcement: Prevents duplicate submissions from the same student
- Timed exams: Configurable countdown timer with automatic test submission upon timer expiry

### 5. Real-Time Gradebook & Digital Report Cards
- Instructor dashboard tracking live student submissions and score distributions
- Question-by-question breakdown showing student answers, correct reference answers, marks, and AI evaluation feedback
- Instant printable and downloadable student report cards

### 6. Automated Teacher Email Center
- Automated notifications dispatched directly to the instructor's verified email upon test publication and student submissions

## URLs & Endpoints
- Homepage & Student Portal: https://testcraftai.online/
- Student Exam Link Pattern: https://testcraftai.online/?test={testId_or_slug}
- Theory Grading API: POST https://testcraftai.online/api/evaluate-theory
- Sitemap: https://testcraftai.online/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://testcraftai.online/robots.txt
- Full LLM Documentation: https://testcraftai.online/llms-full.txt
